in_marathi.name: Vedakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledgeable in Vedas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Veda’ which means knowledge and ‘Kar’ which means doer. The name Vedakar is bestowed upon a boy who is knowledgeable about the Vedas.
